name: The real command types on in a dark terminal
looks: A dark terminal panel fills most of the frame; a single real command types on line by line, a URL flag then a quoted goal string, the cursor blinking at the end once it finishes.
build: terminal-type-on's per-character reveal across two lines instead of one, the second line indented as a continuation; the cursor holds blinking once typing completes, no further motion.
sound: A steady mechanical key tick per character, stopping clean when the command finishes.
prompt: Show the actual command a developer would run, typing on line by line in a dark terminal, a target and a plain-language instruction as its two arguments, holding on the finished command with a blinking cursor before the next beat proves it works.
